title: Research Internship: Future of Insurance with AI Agents
snippet: CITRIS and the Banatao Institute is seeking a research intern to join a collaborative project exploring how artificial intelligence, climate change and other global forces are transforming the insurance industry. The work will be co-supervised by Camille Crittenden, CITRIS Executive Director.
